# Surefire groups for the Build workflow and for the Jenkinsfile (ci.jenkins.io), whose
# planGroups() reads this format and applies the rules of .github/scripts/test-shards.py: change
# both if either changes.
#
# Format: a group starts with a line "[<label>]"; the lines after it, up to the next
# "[<label>]" line, hold its Surefire -Dtest patterns, separated by commas, spaces or line
# breaks. Lines starting with '#' are comments.
#   label    words of lower-case letters and digits separated by single spaces or '-', at
#            most 25 characters. It names the job, "test (jdk 21, <label>)", so say what
#            the group tests. Its id, the label with '-' for every space ("run-approval"),
#            names the surefire-reports artifact and is the argument of "verify".
#   pattern  matched against the simple class name; only letters, digits, '_' and '*' are
#            allowed. Either a prefix ("Grant*Test") or one class name.
#
# Groups are features, by test class name. Estimates per group, from the per-class times of
# Build runs 37885983908, 37883660962 and 37883230719 (six jobs per class: three runs, JDK
# 21 and 25; ~22,400 s of class time per JDK). "s" is the group's mean class time; "min" is
# the job time, mean and slowest of the six samples, from a model that hands the group's
# classes, in the order Surefire runs them (alphabetical by class file), to four forks
# (forkCount 1C on the runner's four cores) and adds ~50 s of compilation and job setup.
# On these runs the model came within 25 s of every measured Maven run of the six earlier
# groups.
#   run requests               31 classes  ~2,420 s  12.1 / 12.7 min
#   run approval and mail      25 classes  ~2,120 s  10.8 / 11.4 min
#   activation and new jobs    24 classes  ~2,220 s  10.8 / 12.2 min
#   incidents refusals reruns  19 classes  ~1,910 s  10.2 / 11.2 min
#   permission windows         29 classes  ~2,430 s  11.7 / 12.7 min
#   items and moves            18 classes  ~2,280 s  10.9 / 11.5 min
#   authorization and links    23 classes  ~2,180 s  11.1 / 12.5 min
#   permissions and plugins    39 classes  ~2,030 s  10.3 / 11.2 min
#   audit history and storage  45 classes  ~2,540 s  12.2 / 13.1 min
#   parameters and ui          27 classes  ~2,340 s  12.2 / 13.6 min
# ItemIdentityBindingTest (~540 s, items and moves) and AuthorizationEntryGuardTest (~530 s,
# authorization and links) are the two slowest classes; each sorts among the first four
# classes of its group, so it starts at once. The six groups these replaced came out, in
# the same model, at 14.5 to 20.6 min (mean) and 21.9 min (slowest sample, run approval and
# mail), against 21.7 min measured.
#
# .github/scripts/test-shards.py check fails the workflow when a test class matches no
# group or more than one group, when a group matches no class and when a pattern matches
# no class (left behind by a rename or a deletion). A new test class whose name starts like
# the classes of one group needs no change here if that group has its prefix; otherwise add
# the prefix or the class name to the group of the feature it tests. Rebalance (move a
# family to another group, or split a feature into two descriptively labelled groups) when
# one group grows much slower than the others.
